_extraction_flags.notes: Channel modeling paper. No Comm metrics (Rate/BER) - only channel characterization.

reasoning_trace.step_0_visual_inspection: Figure 1 & 2: 3D Ray-tracing simulation in Zemax for V2V scenario. Figure 3: Channel Impulse Response (CIR) showing long trailing for Mono-static vs short for Bi-static. Figure 4: Path Loss curves defining 'effective sensing distance'. Figure 6: RMS Delay Spread linear fits.
reasoning_trace.step_1_concept_analysis: System: Visible Light Communication (VLC) in V2V. Mode: ISAC Channel Modeling (not waveform design). Coupling: Investigates physical channel properties for Mono-static vs Bi-static configurations. Framework: 3GPP ISAC channel model (Target + Background).
reasoning_trace.step_2_benchmark_verification: Type: Pure Simulation (Ray Tracing). No experimental data. Comm Metrics (Rate/BER) are NR because the paper focuses on channel characterization (CIR, RMS DS). Sensing 'Effective Distance' is defined based on 25dB path loss threshold: ~4m for Mono, 5-10m for Bi-static.
reasoning_trace.step_3_strategic_critique: Contribution: Characterizes the ISAC channel large-scale fading and dispersion (RMS DS) for V2V. Key Finding: Bi-static sensing has lower and decreasing RMS delay spread (better for high-speed), whereas Mono-static increases with distance. Gap: Simulation only; no actual modulation/demodulation simulation to measuring BER or Sensing Accuracy (RMSE).

bibliographic.title: Analysis of Visible Light-Based ISAC Channel Characteristics in a V2V Scenario
bibliographic.authors: Peiyao Dong, Pan Tang, Yue Yin, Lei Tian, Jianhua Zhang
bibliographic.venue: 2025 IEEE Wireless Communications and Networking Conference (WCNC)

application.scenario_description: V2V communication and sensing using LED taillights. Comparison of mono-static and bi-static sensing channel properties.

key_contribution.key_contribution: Comparative analysis of CIR, Path Loss, and RMS Delay Spread for Mono-static vs Bi-static VLC-ISAC channels in V2V.
key_contribution.gap_addressed: Lack of specific channel characterization for outdoor V2V visible light ISAC considering target/background separation.

transmitter.notes: 120 degree view angle = ~2094 mrad. LED Power 1.8W.

waveform.notes: Focus is on Channel Impulse Response, not specific waveform modulation.

sensing_metrics.notes: Effective sensing range limited to 4m by 25dB path loss threshold.

tradeoff.notes: RMS Delay Spread vs Distance tradeoff.
